text:
julia (sales): quick heads-up — ACME POC is failing when they try to pin model `gptx-8k-v1` in ap-southeast. Mark says request returns `model_not_found`. demo scheduled Wed, need workaround.

mark (ACME): seeing error on our end: `HTTP 404` with body \n```json\n{\n  \"error\": \"model_not_found\",\n  \"model\": \"gptx-8k-v1\",\n  \"region\": \"ap-southeast-1\"\n}\n```\nDemo Wed 09:00 PST — can we get something by Tue EOD?

devon (solutions): can you paste the exact request payload and the `model` field? pinning prevents our usual region-fallback, so that explains it.

mark (ACME): payload snippet: `{"model":"gptx-8k-v1","pin":true,"prompt":"..."}`. No other headers.

kiran (support): pulling logs for that account now. Quick glance: cluster returned `404` from model registry lookup at 2024-05-19T14:12:03Z.
```
LOG 14:12:03 model_lookup: id=gptx-8k-v1 region=ap-southeast-1 result=NOT_FOUND
LOG 14:12:03 request_id=xyz-123 customer=acme-poc
```

olivia (security): FYI Mark also asked in the questionnaire if hosted POC can use customer-managed KMS keys. For hosted we only support platform-managed KMS for POCs; Dedicated/Private supports CMKs. Need to call that out in reply.

devon (solutions): short-term options: 1) remove `pin` for the POC so our routing can fallback to nearest replica (EU or us-west) — fastest but changes latency and could hit data residency concerns; 2) pin to a compatible variant that is replicated in ap-southeast (e.g., `gptx-8k-v1-quant`) — may affect output quality; 3) spin up a Dedicated trial or Private deployment and preload the model (longer, ~6-8h push).

julia (sales): mark — which is acceptable? Also they asked about pricing/uptick for a Dedicated trial with KMS for 2 weeks. Need a ballpark to include in reply.

sarah (finance): ballpark: 2-week Dedicated trial with KMS + reserved 2xA100 capacity ~ $7.5k list; we can offer credit/discount for POC, say $4k-5k negotiated. I'll confirm internal approver.

kiran (support): for accountability I created internal ticket INC-9876 and attached the logs and request payload. tagging @nate_infra.

nate (infra): pinged. quick note: model `gptx-8k-v1` was marked for regional consolidation on 2026-02-01 and we did not replicate the full float model to ap-southeast due to storage/cost. We can push a copy on request — estimate 6-8 hours including validation. If customer needs immediate demo, removing pin + fallback is fastest.

olivia (security): for the KMS question: confirm — hosted POC = platform KMS only. If they require CMK/HSM we must move to Dedicated/Private and run the security onboarding (SLA + questionnaires). I can send the exact SSO/KMS checklist.

devon (solutions): suggested fallback policy to propose to customer in email: `if pinned model unavailable -> allow region-fallback for up to 30s latency increase or route <10% traffic to fallback variant`. Example config snippet: \n```\n{ \"model\": \"gptx-8k-v1\", \"pin\": true, \"fallback_policy\": { \"allow_region_fallback\": true, \"canary_fraction\": 0.1 } }\n```

julia (sales): ok i'll draft an email offering two paths: A) quick demo: remove pin or enable fallback (note: possible latency/quality variance); B) secure POC: Dedicated trial with CMK & preloaded model (6-8h prep) — include sarah's ballpark.

mark (ACME): removing pin for the demo is fine if you note the caveats. For the long term we need CMK. Also want to know if deprecation is permanent or if model will be back in ap-southeast.

nate (infra): deprecation was intentional for that region due to low usage; not permanent — we can replicate on request but it's not auto-synced. I'll keep INC-9876 updated.

kiran (support): INC-9876: https://redwood.internal/inc/9876 — logs attached. I'll also schedule a short runbook to enable fallback in the tenant for the demo window and revert after.

sarah (finance): i'll DM julia with a POC pricing sheet and draft approval language for discounts.

devon (solutions): i'll draft the technical appendix explaining quality delta between `gptx-8k-v1` float vs `gptx-8k-v1-quant` and safe test prompts for the demo.

julia (sales): action summary for Tue EOD deadline:
- kiran: enable temporary fallback (or remove pin) for demo window + link to ticket (INC-9876)
- nate: replicate model if customer prefers preloaded copy (6-8h)
- olivia: provide KMS/security checklist for CMK onboarding
- sarah: provide ballpark quote + discount terms
- devon: technical appendix and safe prompts
I'll update Mark after internal confirmations.

mark (ACME): great — thanks team. Please confirm by Tue EOD PST so i can lock the demo. :thumbsup:

julia (sales): will do. :thumbsup: closing loop once kiran confirms the fallback/INC update.
